what: QA render of the overlay for the landing page and the deck (not a detection, not a measurement)
server: jaga.server.create_app + jaga.daemon.Watcher, the same code jaga serve runs
camera_pane: a test card played through jaga.capture.FileSource (no camera; it reads 'QA render · scripted windows · no camera')
windows: scripted: vectors placed on the negative side, then the positive side, so ARMED -> HOLDING -> TRIPPED happens on cue
theta: set by the QA script: the midpoint of the scripted positive and negative margins (-0.0411, shown as 'v1'); not fitted from clips, not frozen, not a calibration
dwell: tripwire 01 with the 30 s demo dwell (default 120 s), as the overlay shows
plug: the test suite's fake LAN plug (tests/fakeplug.py) on loopback; its acknowledgement time is not a real plug's

compile_drawer.sentence: the stove is on and nobody is in the kitchen
compile_drawer.how: typed into the overlay, one real Token Factory call

header_cropped: the header bar is cut from every shot: under scripted windows its s/clip is not a measurement
